service.en: Permit for agricultural and landscaping works outside the residential plot
service.ar: تصريح أعمال الزراعة والتجميل خارج حدود القسيمة السكنية
service.ur: رہائشی پلاٹ سے باہر زرعی اور باغبانی کے کاموں کا اجازت نامہ
service.ml: റെസിഡൻഷ്യൽ പ്ലോട്ടിന് പുറത്തെ കൃഷി, ലാൻഡ്സ്കേപ്പിംഗ് ജോലികൾക്കുള്ള പെർമിറ്റ്

about: Get a permit for planting and landscaping work on space outside a residential plot, following the Off-Plot Works Manual.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
